title: Power of Myth: At the Ranch
description: A TV interviewer, a myth scholar's last summers, and a filmmaker's California hideout—Go Deep into the week heroes got explained on camera.

questions.question: In the late 1980s, which journalist sat down with Joseph Campbell for the PBS series The Power of Myth?
questions.explanation: Six episodes of patient questions about gods, dreams, and why the same hero keeps showing up. It aired in 1988, the year after Campbell died.

questions.question: Moyers taped most of those Power of Myth talks at which California property?
questions.explanation: Five of the six episodes were filmed there over Campbell's last two summers. Mythology, meet the shop that built lightsabers.

questions.question: Skywalker Ranch belonged to which filmmaker—who later called Campbell "my Yoda"?
questions.explanation: They did not actually meet until after Return of the Jedi; Lucas heard Campbell lecture in 1984. The friendship came after the trilogy, not before.

questions.question: Lucas said which 1949 Campbell book helped shape Star Wars—the one that maps departure, initiation, and return?
questions.answer: The Hero with a Thousand Faces
acceptedAnswers: The Hero with a Thousand Faces
the hero with a thousand faces
questions.explanation: Campbell compared myths across continents and argued their heroes walk one shared path. Lucas used it as a builder's blueprint.

questions.question: In The Hero with a Thousand Faces, Campbell's one-word name for the universal pattern was borrowed from James Joyce's Finnegans Wake. What word?
questions.explanation: Campbell was a Joyce scholar first—he co-wrote A Skeleton Key to Finnegans Wake in 1944. The word traveled from the Wake to every screenwriting lecture on Earth.

questions.question: In Campbell's stages, what does he call the moment the hero first turns down the adventure?
questions.hint: Right after the Call to Adventure—Luke saying he has to stay on the farm

questions.question: After that refusal, Campbell names the helper who gives a talisman or advice. What is that stage called?
questions.hint: Obi-Wan with a lightsaber; Campbell's original term

easterEgg.title: After the trilogy
easterEgg.text: Campbell watched the Star Wars trilogy at Skywalker Ranch and called it "real art." The Power of Myth interviews with Bill Moyers were taped there over Campbell's last two summers.
